english.note: Use this for personally experiencing an activity or situation, often with an emphasis on gaining firsthand knowledge.
Use 體驗 when someone seeks or gains a first-hand experience of something.

examples.english: We went to Japan to soak in hot springs and experience the local culture firsthand.
examples.traditional: 我哋去日本浸溫泉，親身體驗下當地文化。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 zam3 wan1 cyun4 can1 san1 tai2 jim6 haa5 dong1 dei6 man4 faa3

examples.english: I want to explore scuba diving firsthand.
examples.traditional: 我想去沖繩體驗吓潛水。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 cung1 sing4 tai2 jim6 haa5 cim4 seoi2
